style: The players are anonymous: generic athletes with no likeness to anyone, faces turned away, in shadow or left blank. What makes the moment recognisable is the SITUATION - the clock, the distance, the geometry, who is standing and who is falling, the object at the instant - never the player. Team colours are kept; nothing else about the men matters. Every figure named is present in the position described, and nobody else. No text of any kind except a clock where the scene names one; no logos, no wordmarks, no jersey numbers, no border, no caption, no title, no credits, no watermark.

moments.title: The Bounce
moments.look: Minimalist flat vector poster. Three colours only - black, white, red. Huge empty space, tiny figures, geometric shapes, no texture, no gradients.
moments.prompt: The whole poster is black. At the top centre a white basketball hoop drawn as a simple circle and net, and a single red ball resting on the very front of its rim, caught at the top of a bounce, with three faint red ghost-circles beneath it showing the bounces before. Above the hoop a small square reads 0.0 in red. At the very bottom, tiny, two figures: one in black crouched low with both hands on his knees looking up, one in white beside him still in the air with an arm raised. The ball is the only bright thing in the frame.

moments.title: From the Logo
moments.look: Japanese manga action art: black ink lines, dramatic speed lines, screentone shading, extreme perspective, a single accent colour of gold.
moments.prompt: Seen from behind and low: a shooter in a dark navy jersey stands at the half-court logo with both arms still raised after the release, drawn small at the bottom of the frame. In front of him the entire empty half of the court rushes away in extreme perspective to a basketball hoop at the top, drawn tiny and far. The ball tears across that whole distance leaving a gold streak of speed lines, halfway to the rim. Ink on white, the floor lines converging, the crowd a screentone blur. Navy figure, gold ball.

moments.title: The Dagger
moments.look: Cinematic movie-poster painting: realistic bodies and fabric, dramatic volumetric light, deep shadows, film grain, painterly brushwork.
moments.prompt: Low angle from the floor, the whole background a blinding wall of yellow light with a clock hanging in it reading 53.0. A shooter in a black jersey is at the top of a step-back jump shot, leaning back, the ball just off his fingertips above his head, far outside the three-point arc that glows under him. Right in front of him a defender in a white jersey lunges a half step too late, right arm stretched up and past the ball, body off balance. Faces turned away from the viewer. Black and white figures against yellow.

moments.title: The Last Shot
moments.look: Baroque oil painting in the manner of Caravaggio: chiaroscuro, a single warm light source, dark umber background, visible brushstrokes, dramatic classical composition.
moments.prompt: At the top of the key a shooter in a red jersey is frozen in a full follow-through: right arm extended toward a hoop off the top right of the frame, wrist snapped down, fingers hanging, feet just landing. One stride to his left a defender in a white jersey stumbles backward and away from him, off balance, his left hand reaching down for the floor, as if pushed. The ball hangs small in the dark halfway to the rim. A scoreboard glows faintly in the dark above reading 5.2. Both faces hidden in shadow. Red and white in warm light against near-black.

moments.title: The Shrug
moments.look: 1960s pop-art screen print: flat halftone dots, hard black outlines, off-register colour blocks, a bold limited palette of red, white, black and orange.
moments.prompt: A player in a white jersey with red trim, seen from the front and cropped at the waist, shoulders raised and both palms turned up and out in a shrug, head turned to the right. Above him, exactly six basketballs in a row across the top of the frame, each printed in orange halftone. Behind his head a solid red circle like a target. Nothing else. The face is a flat shape with no features.

moments.title: The Flu Game
moments.look: Charcoal and ink wash drawing on grey paper: rough smudged strokes, dripping ink, scratchy lines, almost monochrome with one spot colour.
moments.prompt: Two players in red jerseys, the only colour in the drawing, walking off toward the viewer. The one on the right is slumped and spent, head hanging, knees buckling. The one on the left holds him up with an arm wrapped around his shoulders, taking his weight. A sickly green wash bleeds into the shadows around them. The floor and the crowd dissolve into smeared charcoal. No faces.

moments.title: The Block
moments.look: Soviet constructivist propaganda poster: bold diagonals, flat red, black and cream, geometric shapes, heroic low angle, coarse paper texture.
moments.prompt: A giant hand and forearm in a black sleeve slashes in from the upper left on a hard diagonal and pins a basketball flat against a square of backboard glass, cracks radiating from the ball. Under the rim, a smaller figure in a white jersey is still in the air at the end of a layup, his own hand just below the ball, beaten. The rim is a red circle. Behind everything a field of cream with a black sunburst of diagonal rays. No faces.

moments.title: The Lob
moments.look: Art deco poster of the 1930s: streamlined geometric figures, metallic gold on deep purple, stepped skyscraper motifs, sunburst rays, elegant symmetry.
moments.prompt: A tall figure in gold is above the rim with both hands on the ball, about to dunk, drawn as a streamlined deco statue at the top centre. Far below and to the right, a smaller figure in gold stands with one arm pointed up at the rim, and a thin gold arc runs from his hand up across the frame to the ball. Under the rim, a flat black figure is beaten, arms down. Stepped geometric skyline shapes in dark purple frame the scene. No faces.

moments.title: The Skyhook
moments.look: Ancient Greek black-figure pottery painting: flat black silhouettes on terracotta orange, incised white detail lines, a meander border band, athletes drawn like figures on an amphora.
moments.prompt: A very tall figure, turned sideways, releases a hook shot: one arm raised across his body as a shield, the other fully straight above his head, the ball leaving the fingertips at the very top of the frame. Beside him a shorter figure in a lighter wash reaches up with both arms and falls a full head short of the ball. The ball's arc is an incised line toward a small ring at the top right. Figures in the gold and green of their sides tinted into the black silhouettes. No faces, just the vase-painting profile.

moments.title: The Dream Shake
moments.look: Long-exposure motion photography turned into art: one sharp figure, multiple blurred ghost exposures trailing behind, light streaks, black background, high contrast.
moments.prompt: On the low block with his back to a hoop at the top of the frame, a centre in a red jersey is caught sharp at the end of a spin, pivoting toward the baseline with the ball tucked at his hip and his head turned over his shoulder to find the rim. Three fading ghost exposures of him trail off to the right, showing the fake he sold the other way. Beside him the defender in a white jersey is a smear of motion leaning hard the wrong way, feet crossed, one hand grabbing at nothing. No faces.

moments.title: The Shot
moments.look: Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print: flat colour areas, bold outlines, stylised clouds and waves, a limited palette of indigo, red, cream and black, visible wood grain.
moments.prompt: A shooter in a red jersey hangs in the air at the free-throw line at the very top of his jump, knees tucked, the ball held at the top of a double-clutch release above his head. A defender in a white jersey with orange trim has already flown past him to the left, arm up, too early, falling. Stylised woodblock clouds fill the top of the frame; the hoop stands small at the upper right; a lantern reads 0:03. No faces.

moments.title: From the Line
moments.look: Engineering blueprint: white line drawing on deep blue, measured dimension lines, arcs and angles, grid, the figure drawn like an anatomical diagram.
moments.prompt: Strict side elevation. A figure in flight, body perfectly horizontal, legs split front and back, the ball held high in the leading hand with the arm straight, drawn as a white line diagram. Below him the free-throw line and the rim at the right edge, with a dotted flight arc drawn from the line to the rim and dimension lines measuring the distance between them. Small construction circles mark the take-off and the apex. No face, a blueprint figure only.

moments.title: The Stepover
moments.look: Film noir: stark black-and-white photography feel, one hard key light, venetian-blind shadows, deep grain, a single colour kept - gold.
moments.prompt: Floor level, looking along the hardwood. A small figure in a white jersey with a sleeve on one arm steps over another who lies flat on his back on the floor in a gold jersey, the standing figure towering out of the top of the frame and looking down at him. Long hard shadows run toward the camera; everything beyond is black. Gold is the only colour. No faces.

moments.title: The Dunk of Death
moments.look: Stained-glass window: bold black leading between panes of saturated coloured glass, light glowing through, a tall arched frame, a rose-window halo.
moments.prompt: A figure in dark navy is at the top of a leap, legs spread wide, clearing the head of a much taller figure in white who stands under him and ducks. The ball is slammed one-handed through a hoop in the arch at the top of the window. A rose-window halo glows behind the leaping figure. The glass panes are navy, white, pale blue and gold. No faces, leaded outlines only.
